summary: grid-template-areas lets you draw a layout with names. Each string is a row, each name is a cell, and grid-area puts an element in the cells with its name.
notes: "header header header" makes the header span all three columns. The footer does the same in the last row.
The middle row "nav main aside" places the three middle regions side by side, sized by grid-template-columns.
The shared card style is listed first. The header and aside rules come after it, so their background colors win the tie.
pitfall: Drawing an area that is not a rectangle, such as an L shape. The browser rejects the whole grid-template-areas value and the items stack in order.
